title: Pack and seal a divided lunchbox
instruction: Stand the gray divider in the center guides of the lunchbox. Put the orange packet in the farther compartment and the green packet in the nearer compartment. Place the lid on the box, press all four latches closed, and release it.
context: Packing two foods in separate compartments requires a removable divider and a lid that stays closed when the box is carried.
setup: A 650 × 720 mm wooden worktop supports a fixed, open polypropylene lunchbox about 200 × 150 × 80 mm with paired divider guides. A removable frosted polypropylene lid with four swiveling tabs and a grab handle rests beside it. A gray plastic 146 × 18 × 45 mm divider and two wrapped 56 × 31 × 27 mm packet proxies start outside the box. See the README for the fixed starting poses and YAM base coordinates.
scoring: Use the last 20 controls. Reward 0.15 for a released divider within 10 mm lengthwise and 9 mm across the centerline, within 12 mm vertically of the tub datum and within 5 degrees of vertical. Reward 0.15 per released food packet within 31 mm along the compartment, 23–57 mm to the correct side, 0–16 mm above the tub datum and within 22 degrees of vertical. Reward 0.15 for a released lid within 10 mm horizontally and 9 mm of its seated height, tilted at most 5 degrees. With the lid seated, reward 0.10 for each released latch within 4 degrees of closed. A released object has at most 0.1 N of summed gripper contact.
reset_notes: Return the divider, packets and lid to the documented starting poses and reset the four hinges open.
fidelity: The physical latch geometry and hinge joints come from the source lunchbox. The tub is secured to the worktop. The rigid lid locator has 2.7 mm radial clearance added to let the lid seat. The lid, divider and two simplified rigid food packets move through contact and gravity. The expert uses ordinary arm and gripper commands.
